results.title: IDEX Fluid & Metering Technologies
results.snippet: FMT's diverse range of end markets includes industrial infrastructure, energy, chemical processing, agriculture, food and beverage, semiconductors, and pharmaceuticals. Within it, the Pumps unit makes rotary gear, vane, and lobe pumps, and primarily uses independent distributors to market and sell its products.

results.title: Business Segments
results.snippet: IDEX reports three segments: Fluid & Metering Technologies, Health & Science Technologies, and Fire & Safety/Diversified Products (These products and services are grouped into three reportable segments).

results.title: www.idexcorp.com
results.snippet: IDEX's website says this segment produces firefighting pumps and controls, apparatus valves, monitors, nozzles, rescue tools, lifting bags for the fire and rescue industry.

results.title: IDEX CORP /DE/ - Form 10-K - FY2020
results.snippet: The Energy unit makes flow meters, small volume provers, and terminal automation control systems for fuel and petroleum applications. The Valves unit makes specialty valves for chemical, petrochemical, energy, and sanitary uses.
